reviews.text: The salon is clean and the staff are very friendly. I appreciate that they live-stream the treatment process, which makes me feel at ease leaving my pet there. They also take lots of photos and record my pet's weight and condition each time, which I really appreciate. I plan to continue using their services in the future.

Dear Yumiko Okubo,

Thank you for choosing our store.

We, the entire staff, will strive to provide even better service in the future.

We look forward to seeing you again.
You can rest assured knowing that you can monitor your pet via camera while they are being groomed and staying at the hotel.

I used their shampoo and cut service.

This salon provides a live stream of the grooming process, which is reassuring and makes the waiting time enjoyable.

The brushing and shampooing are done very carefully, and it's inspiring me to do a better job at home.

The finished result was exactly as I requested; my dog ​​looks adorable, and I'm extremely satisfied! She's so fluffy and soft to the touch, I can't stop touching her!

They also take beautiful photos, which is another enjoyable aspect.

Furthermore, when I went to pick up my dog, I saw how much the staff cared for the dogs in their care, which made me feel at ease leaving my dog ​​there.

I would definitely like to use their services again in the future!

Thank you for your consistently courteous service. I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​with you.

My dog ​​seems to be having a great time! 🐶
I was able to watch the grooming process, and the staff were very friendly. I also appreciated that they gave me photos.

I used their grooming service.

The live stream showing my dog's progress was fantastic.

The fact that they allowed me to leave my dog ​​until 10 PM and let him play in the play area after grooming was also a great plus.

I will definitely use their service again.
The staff were very kind, and they provided detailed updates via LINE, so I felt at ease leaving my pet in their care. I would like to use their services again.

This was my dog's first time getting groomed at a salon.
I was worried my dog ​​might get nervous, but being able to watch the grooming process live put my mind at ease.
She came back looking absolutely adorable, and I'm very happy!
I'll definitely be back!

I felt completely at ease entrusting my puppy to their grooming service for the first time. I was worried because he's a puppy, but they were incredibly gentle and kind, and I could watch him getting his hair cut and shampooed live, and I was so glad I chose them for his first grooming experience. They also readily accommodated my requests and provided service that exceeded my expectations. I would definitely like to use their services again next time.

I'm a regular customer.

The staff's service, the atmosphere of the shop, and the cleanliness are all excellent; it's a wonderful place.

We stayed at the hotel for 2 nights and 3 days.

The facilities were very clean.

The staff were all cheerful, kind, and extremely helpful.

They sent us update messages several times a day via LINE and responded promptly to our requests, so we felt very at ease leaving our dog there.

Also, there were cameras not only in the play area but also in the individual rooms, so we were happy to be able to check on our dog no matter where he was.

The attention to detail was excellent, and we would definitely like to use their services again.

This was my first time using your services.

This salon allows you to watch the grooming process live, and for the first time, I was able to see my dog's true behavior.

I was surprised because she's usually a very calm dog at home, but I'm truly grateful that the groomer was so kind and attentive throughout the entire process.

After the grooming, they explained her condition in detail, and I was very happy that they said, "It's not due to a lack of training, but rather a congenital fear or something from past experiences," showing consideration for my feelings as a pet owner.

I also felt reassured by their attitude of prioritizing Latte's health and adjusting the grooming process without pushing her too hard.

I don't think there are many salons that are so caring and attentive.

In the future, I'm thinking about training and other options to gradually reduce Latte's stress.

Thank you so much.

I chose this pet care facility because it's clean, has pet cameras in both the play area and the private rooms, and is very convenient. They also sent me very polite messages via LINE, including photos and videos after every meal, which gave me great peace of mind. They even sent me these beautiful photos at the end, and I'm very satisfied.

I will definitely use this facility again when I need to leave my dog. 🐶
I was so relieved when you sent me photos and videos 🥸 Thank you so much 🥸 …

I used your service for the first time the other day.

Being able to watch the grooming process via live stream was very reassuring, and I felt that this kind of service is only possible if the company has confidence in its skills and customer service.

The finished result was meticulous, and I am very satisfied.

Also, I appreciate that you can look after my dog ​​for up to two hours before and after grooming. I was late picking up my dog, but you were very flexible and helpful. It seemed my dog ​​played with the other dogs at the daycare, and I was relieved to see that he was relaxed.

I would like to use your service again in the future.

Thank you for your grooming services.

They were very gentle and careful with my dog, and I felt very at ease knowing I could watch the process via live stream.

I'm very happy with the adorable result.

After the grooming, they let my dog ​​interact with other dogs in the free space and gave me detailed feedback on how she was doing.

I would definitely like to use their services again.

I requested a trial day at the nursery school. My errands took longer than expected, and I was late picking up my child, but they kindly accommodated my request. I also mentioned that my child tends to eat quickly, so I asked them to feed him/her slowly, and they kindly sent me photos of that process. I was able to see him/her in real time via camera during the day, which gave me peace of mind throughout. After returning home, I received a diary with photos and lots of cute pictures via LINE. I am very satisfied. I would like to try their grooming services next time.

Dear MIDORIKO YAMANAKA,

Thank you for using our grooming services.

We, the entire staff, will continue to strive to provide even better service.

We look forward to seeing you again.

I used their service for grooming.

Being able to check on my pet with a camera gave me peace of mind.

I chose this service because I liked the idea of ​​being able to watch a video, but the way they treated my dog ​​was terrible. Even with all the options and the most expensive course, they didn't wash him gently in a container like they do on Instagram; they just scrubbed him roughly in the washing area, and they worked mechanically without saying a word to him. When it came to the haircut, even though I told them my back hurt, they seemed annoyed and forced my dog ​​to stand up whenever he sat down, and they also cut his face roughly, which made me very uneasy about how they treated him. My dog ​​was scared when we got home, and I was mentally unstable for a while afterward. You should definitely watch the video. I have a video record, so I'm wondering what to do next. I got the impression that they only treat dogs gently for Instagrammers' dogs or for Instagram purposes.

They took such good care of my dog ​​who can't stay home alone.

The shampooing was done carefully, and I was relieved to see her relaxed on the live camera.

Previously, at another temporary boarding facility, she was kept in a cage for too long, which caused her stress.

This time, I really did my research before choosing this place.

She had fun with her cute friends, so I would like to ask them to board her again when needed.

The shop was very clean, bright, and beautiful. All the staff were very friendly, and I felt at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care.

The price was reasonable considering the services provided, and I think it's a fair price. The fact that they took photos of my dog ​​during grooming was also reassuring and very helpful.

I was very happy with the result and would definitely like to use their services again.

This was my first time using their service and it was fantastic!
The staff were so kind, and my dog ​​was completely relaxed.
The finished result was adorable, and I'm extremely happy with it! 🐶
I also appreciate that they're open late. I'd love to use their services again! …

I made an appointment for 4pm, but they said they were running late on the previous dog, so I had to wait about 40 minutes before I could start. Up to that point, it was within an acceptable range.

However, when I went to pick up my dog, a different person tried to charge me the regular price, even though it was my first time. Even when I explained that it was my first time, they didn't confirm it right away, and there was no apology afterwards either.

Their attitude was forceful throughout, which made me feel very uncomfortable. It's very disappointing considering it's not a cheap service.

It was the first time I've ever felt so uncomfortable shampooing my dog. I don't think I'll be using their services again.

We stayed at the hotel for five nights this time.
The facility was very clean, and there was no noticeable smell after we picked him up. In fact, he returned smelling nice, which made it clear that he was well-cared for.
They had cameras, and when I looked into the area, I saw that they immediately noticed when a dog defecate and cleaned it up with disinfectant, which I was impressed by how cleanliness is maintained so highly.
The dogs staying at the facility were all well-behaved and well-behaved, and it was reassuring to see them all relaxing and enjoying themselves in the area, keeping a good distance between them.
I requested a quick pick-up and drop-off service to my home on the day I picked him up, and he was there just 30 minutes after I contacted him. I was amazed at how smoothly the service was handled! Thank you.
You also sent me the attached photos on the last day. Thank you for your attentive service.

I was so satisfied that I will never leave my dog ​​at another hotel again. I will definitely use your services again.

The best thing about this salon is that they live-stream the shampooing and trimming process, which is something you won't find at other salons. It's reassuring to see that they're treating my pet with care. 
The cut around the bottom was very neat and I thought the technicians were very skilled! The room was spacious and bright while we waited. I'd like to try using them as a pet hotel next time.

Both the hotel and kindergarten are popular, and the floor is always bustling.
I decided to use this hotel because of its location, good reviews, the fact that there are cameras in the free space and in each room, and the long opening hours.

I used the hotel for one kindergarten trial and two kindergarten visits, and stayed at the pet hotel for three days and two nights.
You can send a diary when you use the kindergarten (more than five hours) and on the last day of your stay at the hotel.
I was able to provide a bulleted list of tips on feeding, walks, how to spend time, and how to care for your pet, and they responded accordingly.
The staff were also very friendly in person, and kept in touch frequently via LINE, which left a good impression. I think I would definitely leave my pet at a place like this.

This was my first time getting my dog ​​groomed! 

The shop has a nice atmosphere, is clean, and they listened carefully to my requests for the cut. 

What I particularly liked was that they live-streamed the shampooing and cut, so I was able to see my dog ​​in action, something I don't usually get to see, which gave me peace of mind. 

The results were great, so I'd definitely like to use their services again!

I had to leave my dog ​​at the last minute, so I made a reservation the day before, which made me anxious. However, they kept me updated by checking on him via camera at all times, taking pictures during walks and meals, and reporting his progress, which made me feel very at ease. 🙌🏻
He seemed to be having a great time, which was a relief. 🐶
Thank you very much.
